purpose: Train and assess an actual improved steering readout without changing recorded validation outcomes.
feature_protocol: Frozen existing CNN, RGB, crop bottom 150 rows, resize to 200x66, /255, 1152 convolutional features.
selection: Minimum MAE on the final 20% block inside the original training partition; refit on all sampled training rows.
reporting: All 9082 original validation rows, plus training-derived constant baselines; no independent-test or closed-loop claim. The existing validation partition has been examined previously.
rating: No guaranteed score; scientific strength depends on measured evidence.
